headline: Anand Mahindra Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Anand Mahindra filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4), signalling a substantial acquisition of shares or change in control threshold in Mahindra & Mahindra Limited.
detail: Anand Mahindra submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE, a mandatory filing required under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 whenever a person or group acquires or agrees to acquire shares or voting rights that cross specified thresholds (typically 25%, 50%, or 75%). The filing does not specify the quantum of shares or the consideration involved, but the regulatory trigger indicates a material change in shareholding or control. Such disclosures are public documents and must be filed within four days of the triggering event.
